children: The attacker behind the July hack of payment services firm Triple-A moved about $12.4 million worth of Ether to mixing service Tornado Cash, Odaily reported on Oct. 10.
The hacker transferred 4,970 Ether to Tornado Cash, according to the report. The attacker stole about $11.8 million of Triple-A’s corporate treasury assets in July.

The stolen funds were later moved to the Ethereum network and exchanged into Ether before being sent to two wallets on Sept. 6. On Oct. 9, the funds were consolidated into a single wallet and deposited into Tornado Cash over a total of 56 transactions.
Triple-A had previously said the hack did not affect customer funds.

title: Triple-A Hacker Moves $12.4 Million in Ether to Tornado Cash
